description: Korean employment contract (근로계약서) required-terms check for an employer or worker. Give the worker type (regular, fixed-term, part-time) and which terms the written contract contains; returns the missing required terms (근로기준법 제17조·시행령 제8조: wage, wage components/calculation/payment method, contracted hours, weekly holiday, annual leave, workplace and duties, work rules; fixed-term and part-time also need contract period and breaks (기간제법 제17조), part-time also working days and hours per day), whether a written copy was handed over, the fine/penalty exposure, and exceptions for workplaces under 5 employees or under 15 hours a week. Checklist only; never drafts the contract.

handedOver.description: A signed copy was handed to the worker

kind.description: regular = open-ended full-time, fixedTerm = fixed-term contract, partTime = short-time worker

small.description: Workplace has 4 or fewer regular employees

weeklyHours.description: Contracted weekly hours (for the under-15-hours exceptions)

written.description: Terms that ARE written in the contract: wage (임금(금액)), wageCalc (임금의 구성항목·계산방법·지급방법), hours (소정근로시간), breaks (휴게시간), holiday (휴일(주휴일)), annualLeave (연차 유급휴가), place (일하는 장소와 하는 일), term (근로계약기간), workdays (근로일과 근로일별 근로시간), rules (취업규칙에서 정한 사항(제93조 1~12호))

name: check_kr_employment_contract
title: Check Korea employment contract
